The tool only supports searching for vegan or gluten‑free items; it does not support “vegetarian” directly. We can request gluten‑free items (which may include some vegetarian options) but cannot specifically filter for vegetarian. We'll proceed with a call requesting both categories if possible.

We need to use `walmart_vegan_products` because we have no direct vegetarian category. Let's pass location as "Denver, CO". For categories, we might specify ["gluten-free"] since there's no vegetarian option. If we want to get all vegan items too, we could combine them? But the API expects one category type per argument. It says default empty array. So maybe just ask for gluten-free. That will return gluten-free items which likely includes many vegetarian ones. There's no way to explicitly request vegetarian.
